renderer_observer.scene: WorldView.scene / WorldSnapshot.scene21: region, opaque instance, actual instanceTemplate from the runtime registry; null inner fields for the ordinary world.

renderer_observer.animation: explicit source reference first; baseline-qualified exact method/recipe numeric bindings; otherwise exact source action/recipe/style/spell identity, never nearby-object or unrelated sequence guessing
